title: Benefit Debts and Overpayment Recovery — Longest Repayment Term Where a Financial Status Report Is on File
content:
The longest repayment term open to a debtor on a debt in **Benefit Debts and Overpayment Recovery** depends on a Financial Status Report on file with a recent waiver request and on the balance.

**Rule.** When a waiver request with a Financial Status Report attached was received on the debt in the last six calendar months counted back from today and the outstanding balance is at least the report-balance threshold of 3000.00 USD, the longest term is the longest plan approved with a Financial Status Report. When such a request was received and the balance is below 3000.00 USD, the longest term is the mid-length term of 36 months. Without such a request, this rule sets no longest term.

**Longest plan approved with a Financial Status Report**, by debt type: 60 months for each of Education Overpayment (Chapters 30, 35 and 1606), Post-9/11 GI Bill Housing and Books Overpayment, Post-9/11 GI Bill Tuition and Fees Overpayment, Disability Compensation Overpayment, Veterans Pension Overpayment and Home Loan Guaranty Debt.

**The six-month period.** A waiver request falls in it when fewer than six whole calendar months have passed from its date of receipt to today: on 20 October, a request received on 21 April counts and one received on 20 April does not. Only a waiver request with the report attached counts; a repayment plan request never carries a report.

| Waiver request with a report received in the period | Balance | Longest term |
|---|---|---|
| Yes | 3,000.00 USD or more | 60 months |
| Yes | Below 3,000.00 USD | 36 months |
| No | Any | None under this rule |

**Hypothetical cases.** A balance of 3,000.00 USD with such a request: 60 months. A balance of 2,999.99 USD with such a request: 36 months. A waiver request without a report attached: none under this rule.
